test_policy.notes: The SAT or ACT is not required for admission or scholarship consideration; scores sent directly from the testing agency (SAT code 1829, ACT code 3338) are considered in holistic review. SAT EBRW 500 or ACT English 18 can also serve as English-proficiency proof. Merit scholarship awards are based on GPA and curriculum.

requirements.notes: Apply through UA's own application. Required for first-time international students: official secondary transcripts with projected graduation date, a NACES course-by-course credential evaluation (TEC, WES, ECE, IEE or IFCS), and proof of English proficiency; SAT/ACT is optional. CDS C13 reports no application fee, but the International Center scholarship page mentions an 'application fee' in a deadline table, so the international fee is left null. First-time international students typically cannot start in summer. Official documents are needed for admission, scholarships and the I-20.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Page lists 'Fall: June 1; Spring: October 1' without a year; taken as fall 2027 (spring 2027 would be Oct. 1, 2026). Rolling admission; if documents arrive after the deadline the application may be deferred to the next semester. Domestic first-years (CDS C14): priority date May 1, closing date Aug. 1, decisions rolling from Oct. 1. The scholarships page has a table with a May 1 fall date under its transfer-student heading; June 1 from the 'how to apply' page is used.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for: 3 or more years of high school in a school whose primary language of instruction is English; citizens of the page's list of English-exempt countries; IB English score of 5 (higher level) or 6 (standard level); A-level English Language or Language and Literature grade C or higher; AP English Language or Literature score of 3 or higher; a completed US college English Composition course with C or better; or a passing ESL/ELI program at another regionally accredited US college. Scores must be less than two years old; institutional TOEFL is not accepted. The page does not mention a conditional-admission or English pathway program.

english.notes: Page states 'minimum score is 3.5 for tests taken after January 21, 2026' without naming the 1-6 scale.
C1 Advanced (CAE). Also accepted: SAT EBRW 500, ACT English 18, LanguageCert Academic 65, GTEC 1126/1135.

aid.notes: New international freshmen are automatically considered for merit scholarships with admission (based on GPA and curriculum, amounts vary; 12+ credits per semester, normally renewable for four years while in good standing at 2.0 GPA). The 2026-27 scholarship table does not state international-specific amounts. CDS H6: 200 nonresident undergraduates received institutional non-need aid, average $9,112.
